chunks: And if they strive to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. And keep company with them in this world with kindness, and follow the way of him who turns to Me. Then to Me is your return, so I will inform you about what you used to do.
ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim behave towards parents who urge them to commit shirk?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the hierarchy of obedience, prioritizing divine monotheism over parental authority while mandating 'ma'ruf' (kindness and good conduct) to maintain familial bonds. Scholars highlight the phrase 'sabil man anaba ilay' as a call to emulate those who have turned back to God, reinforcing the concept of gradual spiritual return. This balance ensures that disobedience in worship does not sever emotional ties, preserving the social fabric of the family unit.
